entry.title: Nvidia in talks to invest in Perplexity at $30 billion-plus valuation

Perplexity's annualized revenue has tripled to over $750 million. Much of Nvidia's investment money tends to flow back as revenue when portfolio companies buy its chips. entry.title: UK Fintech Funding Drops to Lowest Level in At Least a Decade
